author: blu
body: Phase-discipline twin of __str_concat. Always allocates a fresh result text in the deck region (via R14-saved deck-pos cell) and copies a's bytes then b's bytes into it. The bivy in-place fast path from __str_concat is intentionally dropped: it relies on a's bytes ending exactly at the bivy bump pointer R10, which never holds for a deck-allocated source and would dangle if the bivy strikes. emit-binary-op for IrAppendText dispatches here when st.deck-bound is True at the call site.

author: blu
body: The digits are accumulated as one integer and the decimal point is recorded as a count of fractional digits; the scaling is then a single divide by ten to that power.
